name: LOW-VIX armed trend continuation — hashrate cross-up secular-strength ride (BTC)
rationale: Thesis: BTC trends in calm regimes (VIX lt vix_ceiling) are most durable when network security is expanding — rising hashrate signals miner conviction and capex committed to the network. Confirm with btc_hashrate crossing UP through its trend (cross_up ONLY — hashrate is a DRIFTING, near-monotonic series, so a raw level would just encode the secular climb) and require positive price momentum (ret_Nd gt mom_floor). Exit on momentum roll-over or risk/time stops. Long-horizon, very low turnover. Disconfirmer 1 (does the hashrate cross add edge?): a low-VIX + BTC-momentum-only sibling with NO hashrate cross is in the cohort — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, miner-conviction confirmation is dead weight. Disconfirmer 2 (drift trap): btc_hashrate enters ONLY via cross_up, so its secular growth cannot masquerade as a level. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must hold or it is one-halving-cycle luck.
catalyst: VIX calm AND BTC hashrate cross up AND positive momentum
